verdict.rationale: Kimi ships an official terminal CLI, Kimi Code CLI, launched with `kimi`. It can read code, edit files, run commands and search the web, and editors like JetBrains and Zed connect to it over ACP. A community user who compared it with OpenCode independently confirms it exists and is used. Missing for 10: detailed command reference and installation documentation in the evidence pack.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI

citations.quote: Chat with AI in the terminal, letting it read code, edit files, execute commands, search the web, and autonomously complete development tasks.
run `kimi` in the terminal to start; on first use, log in to the Kimi Code platform with the `/login` command to complete the connection
Other editors such as JetBrains and Zed can connect via CLI's ACP protocol.
Compatible with Kimi Code CLI, Claude Code, VS Code, and other mainstream agent tools
